user_preference: Use available connected GitHub/GitLab/Google and other task-relevant sources; avoid making the user restate already verified project decisions.

publication_rules: Publish related memory pointers atomically when possible.

model_independence: Do not infer entitlement/capability or defect authorship from historical model labels. Evidence standards apply at every tier.
responsive_layout_checks: Preserve the Liquidity reference fixed left rail above 900px across XRBC Trade, Liquidity and XRBitcoin; keep app/token identities separate.
Identify exact page from screenshot and source; distinguish XRBC homepage from XRBitcoin.
Move complete position/inset/height/display/navigation/content-offset resets together when changing a breakpoint.
Check screenshot width and widths immediately below/above old and new breakpoints.
Account for selector specificity and refresh CSS cache key.
Label source cascade, rendered geometry, served build and live wallet checks separately.
wallet_event_checks: ready does not establish a signed-in account by itself.
Bridge browser events only during an explicit active attempt using current SDK, version and cancellation state.
Read the current account getter on each event; retain backend readiness and verified app/account identity before connected state.
Distinguish synthetic verification from real-device authorization.

execution_efficiency_preference.source: Explicit user instruction after this deployment
execution_efficiency_preference.rule: Keep work narrowly limited to the requested action and conserve credits. For deployment requests, deploy the requested page, perform only essential checks, make a concise checkpoint update, and stop. Do not add audits, broad research, screenshots, extra test suites, repeated verification, or unrelated repairs unless needed to resolve a concrete blocker or explicitly requested. Reuse existing evidence. Ask before materially expanding scope; do not ask again for an already authorized deployment.
execution_efficiency_preference.reporting: Brief outcome and any concrete blocker or unverified behavior; no long activity narration.
execution_efficiency_preference.discovery_extension: Apply memory/discovery-efficiency-standard.json: broad supported discovery, exact asset identity, honest coverage, plain-language liquidity cautions and bounded focused verification.
